headline: Re-imaging dominates every arm (re-imaging share: lab 53.4%). Compute wall per evaluated study (re-imaging and scoring only; load, prep, adjacency, warm-up and the summary excluded): lab 1.261 s.

split.basis: worker wall seconds (perf_counter in single-thread workers) summed over studies; not CPU time
